statement: Each quest has at most one live claiming session across all worktrees: a second claimant is refused with the holder named, a lease dies with its worktree or a lapsed heartbeat rather than outliving its session, and no append-only quest log can be forked by two concurrent writers.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Session records live under the git common dir, never under gitignored solve/state (gitignored means per-worktree, invisible to the sessions it should coordinate).
A session is live while its worktree exists AND its heartbeat is fresh; solver commands are short-lived processes, so pid liveness must not be a lease criterion.
A live conflicting lease refuses the claim naming the holder worktree, branch, and heartbeat; LAGRANGE_SESSION_LEASE_BYPASS is the only escape and the refusal message names it.

Registry unavailability (unreadable dir, corrupt session file) degrades to a printed warning; only a LIVE conflicting lease blocks quest work — the registry is a coordination aid, not an integrity invariant.
Every registry read prunes sessions whose worktree vanished or whose heartbeat lapsed, so stranded tmp-worktree registrations cannot hold leases past a reboot.
